title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a… (CVE-2026-80265)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to potentially expose information and impact the integrity of the application. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
